https://example.com/a
https://example.com/b

https://example.com/ba

https://example.com/page10

example.com

# --- @ in path (not credentials: comes after the first /) ---
https://medium.com/@username/my-first-post-1a2b3c
https://example.com/user@domain

# --- + (plus, often means space in queries) ---
https://example.com/c++/tutorial
https://example.com/search?q=c++
https://example.com/search?q=hello+world

# --- parentheses ---
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C_(programming_language)#History

# --- sub-delimiters in paths: , ; ! $ ' * = ---
https://example.com/a,b,c
https://example.com/path;jsessionid=ABC123
https://example.com/matrix;color=red;size=10/items
https://example.com/wow!
https://example.com/price$100
https://example.com/it's-a-page
https://example.com/files/*.txt
https://example.com/path=with=equals
https://maps.google.com/?q=44.4268,26.1025

# --- every allowed symbol in one path ---
https://example.com/~a!b$c&d'e(f)g*h+i,j;k=l:m@n

# --- [ ] in query strings (PHP/Rails style arrays) ---
https://example.com/?filter[name]=john&filter[age]=30
https://example.com/?ids[]=1&ids[]=2

# --- URL inside a query string ---
https://example.com/?redirect=https://other.com/page
https://example.com/?q=a%2Fb%3Fc%3D

# --- percent-encoded non-English characters (upper and lower case hex) ---
https://example.com/caf%C3%A9
https://example.com/%E2%9C%93
https://example.com/%e2%9c%93
https://twitter.com/search?q=%23python&src=typed_query

# --- internationalized domains in punycode form (café.com, bücher.de) ---
https://xn--caf-dma.com
https://xn--bcher-kva.de/page

# --- fragment edge cases ---
https://example.com/#/dashboard/settings
https://example.com/page#:~:text=hello
https://example.com/?
https://example.com/#

# --- odd but legal paths ---
https://example.com//double//slashes
https://example.com/./a/../b
